CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_commercial_summary(_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'state', public.account_commercial_state(a.id),
    'trial', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind', g.kind, 'starts_at', g.starts_at, 'ends_at', g.ends_at, 'reason', g.reason, 'notes', g.notes, 'convertible', g.convertible, 'billing_starts_on', g.billing_starts_on, 'revoked_at', g.revoked_at)
              FROM public.access_grants g WHERE g.account_id = a.id AND g.kind <> 'legacy' ORDER BY g.revoked_at IS NULL DESC, g.ends_at DESC LIMIT 1),
    'legacy', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.access_grants g WHERE g.account_id = a.id AND g.kind = 'legacy' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL),
    'subscription', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('status', s.status, 'next_due_on', s.next_due_on, 'next_amount_cents', s.contracted_price_cents, 'promo_price_cents', s.promo_price_cents, 'promo_cycles', s.promo_cycles, 'regular_price_cents', s.regular_price_cents,
              'paid_cycles', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payments p WHERE p.subscription_id = s.id AND p.status = 'confirmed'))
              FROM public.account_subscriptions s WHERE s.account_id = a.id)
  ) FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.id = _account_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_client_directory(_actor_user_id uuid, _search text DEFAULT ''::text, _status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, _payment text DEFAULT 'all'::text, _role text DEFAULT 'all'::text, _sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, _page integer DEFAULT 1, _page_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; needle text := '%' || replace(replace(replace(trim(_search), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
BEGIN
 IF public.platform_admin_role_for(_actor_user_id)::text IS NULL OR public.platform_admin_role_for(_actor_user_id)::text NOT IN ('super_admin','support_admin') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts WHERE owner_user_id=_actor_user_id AND status='active' AND blocked_at IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso não autorizado.'; END IF;
 IF _page < 1 OR _page_size < 10 OR _page_size > 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Paginação inválida.'; END IF;
 WITH directory AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT u.id, p.account_id, coalesce(nullif(p.full_name,''),'Cadastro incompleto') AS name, coalesce(u.email,'E-mail indisponível') AS email, p.profession,p.phone, coalesce(a.created_at,u.created_at) AS created_at, u.last_sign_in_at, coalesce(p.onboarding_completed,false) AS onboarding_completed, coalesce(a.status,'active') AS account_status,a.blocked_at,pa.role::text AS platform_role, sub.status::text AS subscription_status,sub.contracted_price_cents,sub.next_due_on,pl.name AS plan_name,pay.status::text AS payment_status, act.occurred_at AS last_activity_at
 FROM auth.users u LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=u.id LEFT JOIN public.accounts a ON a.id=p.account_id
 LEFT JOIN public.platform_admins pa ON pa.user_id=u.id AND pa.revoked_at IS NULL
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.status,s.contracted_price_cents,s.next_due_on,s.plan_id FROM public.account_subscriptions s WHERE s.account_id=a.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id LIMIT 1) sub ON true
 LEFT JOIN public.subscription_plans pl ON pl.id=sub.plan_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status FROM public.payments WHERE account_id=a.id ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 1) pay ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT occurred_at FROM public.usage_events WHERE account_id=a.id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1) act ON true
 WHERE (trim(_search)='' OR p.full_name ILIKE needle OR u.email ILIKE needle OR p.phone ILIKE needle OR u.id::text ILIKE needle OR a.id::text ILIKE needle)
 AND (_status='all' OR CASE WHEN _status='blocked' THEN a.blocked_at IS NOT NULL ELSE a.status=_status END)
 AND (_role='all' OR coalesce(pa.role::text,'professional')=_role)
 AND (_payment='all' OR CASE WHEN _payment='none' THEN pay.status IS NULL WHEN _payment='pending' THEN pay.status::text IN ('pending','under_review') ELSE pay.status::text=_payment END)
 ), paged AS (
 SELECT * FROM directory ORDER BY CASE WHEN _sort='name' THEN name END ASC, CASE WHEN _sort='oldest' THEN created_at END ASC, CASE WHEN _sort='last_activity' THEN last_activity_at END DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN _sort='newest' THEN created_at END DESC, id
 LIMIT _page_size OFFSET ((_page::bigint-1)*_page_size)
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',(SELECT count(*) FROM directory),'page',_page,'pageSize',_page_size,'rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',d.id,'accountId',d.account_id,'name',d.name,'email',d.email,'profession',d.profession,'phone',d.phone,'createdAt',d.created_at,'lastSignInAt',d.last_sign_in_at,'onboardingCompleted',d.onboarding_completed,'accountStatus',d.account_status,'accountBlocked',d.blocked_at IS NOT NULL,'platformRole',d.platform_role,'subscriptionStatus',d.subscription_status,'planName',d.plan_name,'monthlyCents',d.contracted_price_cents,'nextDueOn',d.next_due_on,'paymentStatus',d.payment_status,'lastActivityAt',d.last_activity_at,
 'lastPaymentAt',(SELECT max(confirmed_at) FROM public.payments WHERE account_id=d.account_id AND status='confirmed'),
 'specialties',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(s.name ORDER BY s.name) FROM public.profile_specialties ps JOIN public.specialties s ON s.id=ps.specialty_id WHERE ps.profile_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 )) FROM paged d),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_overview_summary(_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; m timestamptz:=date_trunc('month',now()); y timestamptz:=date_trunc('year',now());
BEGIN
 IF public.platform_admin_role_for(_actor_user_id) IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts WHERE owner_user_id=_actor_user_id AND status='active' AND blocked_at IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso não autorizado.'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'generatedAt',now(),'telemetrySince',(SELECT min(occurred_at) FROM public.usage_events WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '30 days'),
 'users',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'active',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='active'),'suspended',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='suspended'),'closed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='closed'),'newToday',count(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>=date_trunc('day',now())),'newMonth',count(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>=m),'new7Days',count(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>=now()-interval '7 days'),'new30Days',count(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>=now()-interval '30 days'),'onboardingPending',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE NOT onboarding_completed)) FROM public.accounts WHERE deleted_identity_at IS NULL),
 'subscriptions',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('active',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='active'),'awaiting',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('awaiting_first_payment','payment_pending')),'grace',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='grace_period'),'restricted',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='restricted'),'cancelled',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='cancelled')) FROM public.account_subscriptions),
 'finance',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('receivedMonthCents',coalesce(sum(amount_cents) FILTER(WHERE status='confirmed' AND coalesce(confirmed_at,paid_at)>=m AND coalesce(confirmed_at,paid_at)<m+interval '1 month'),0),'receivedYearCents',coalesce(sum(amount_cents) FILTER(WHERE status='confirmed' AND coalesce(confirmed_at,paid_at)>=y AND coalesce(confirmed_at,paid_at)<y+interval '1 year'),0),'expectedMonthCents',coalesce(sum(amount_cents) FILTER(WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded','rejected') AND due_on>=m::date AND due_on<(m+interval '1 month')::date),0),'pendingCount',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('pending','under_review')),'overdueCount',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='overdue'),'due7DaysCents',coalesce(sum(amount_cents) FILTER(WHERE status NOT IN ('confirmed','refunded','cancelled','rejected') AND due_on::timestamptz>=now() AND due_on::timestamptz<now()+interval '7 days'),0),'due30DaysCents',coalesce(sum(amount_cents) FILTER(WHERE status NOT IN ('confirmed','refunded','cancelled','rejected') AND due_on::timestamptz>=now() AND due_on::timestamptz<now()+interval '30 days'),0),'mrrCents',(SELECT coalesce(sum(contracted_price_cents),0) FROM public.account_subscriptions WHERE status='active')) FROM public.payments),
 'usage',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('activeAccounts7',count(DISTINCT account_id) FILTER(WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '7 days'),'activeAccounts30',count(DISTINCT account_id),'events30',count(*)) FROM public.usage_events WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '30 days'),
 'registrationsByMonth',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',CASE extract(month FROM month)::integer WHEN 1 THEN 'jan.' WHEN 2 THEN 'fev.' WHEN 3 THEN 'mar.' WHEN 4 THEN 'abr.' WHEN 5 THEN 'mai.' WHEN 6 THEN 'jun.' WHEN 7 THEN 'jul.' WHEN 8 THEN 'ago.' WHEN 9 THEN 'set.' WHEN 10 THEN 'out.' WHEN 11 THEN 'nov.' ELSE 'dez.' END,'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts WHERE created_at>=month AND created_at<month+interval '1 month' AND deleted_identity_at IS NULL)) ORDER BY month) FROM generate_series(m-interval '5 months',m,interval '1 month') month)
 ) INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_professional_directory(_actor_user_id uuid, _search text, _status text, _access text, _financial text, _from date, _to date, _sort text, _page integer, _page_size integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; q text := lower(coalesce(trim(_search), ''));
  lim integer := least(greatest(coalesce(_page_size, 20), 1), 50);
  off integer := greatest(coalesce(_page, 1) - 1, 0) * least(greatest(coalesce(_page_size, 20), 1), 50);
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_billing_admin(_actor_user_id, true);
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id, a.created_at, p.full_name, u.email::text AS email,
           public.admin_professional_row(a.id) AS info
    FROM public.accounts a
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = a.owner_user_id
    LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = a.owner_user_id
    WHERE a.status <> 'closed' AND a.deleted_identity_at IS NULL
  ), counts AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'total', count(*),
      'incomplete', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' = 'incomplete'),
      'with_access', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' IN ('active','payment_pending','free','trial','trial_ending')),
      'trial', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' IN ('trial','trial_ending')),
      'trial_ending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' = 'trial_ending'),
      'trial_expired', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' = 'trial_expired'),
      'active', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' = 'active'),
      'suspended', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'status' = 'suspended'),
      'payment_pending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'financial' = 'pending'),
      'overdue', count(*) FILTER (WHERE info->>'financial' = 'overdue' OR info->>'status' = 'overdue')
    ) AS c FROM base
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM base WHERE
      (q = '' OR lower(coalesce(full_name, '')) LIKE '%' || q || '%' OR lower(coalesce(email, '')) LIKE '%' || q || '%')
      AND (coalesce(_status, 'all') = 'all'
           OR (_status = 'with_access' AND info->>'status' IN ('active','payment_pending','free','trial','trial_ending'))
           OR (_status = 'trial_any' AND info->>'status' IN ('trial','trial_ending'))
           OR info->>'status' = _status)
      AND (coalesce(_access, 'all') = 'all' OR info->>'access_type' = _access)
      AND (coalesce(_financial, 'all') = 'all' OR info->>'financial' = _financial)
      AND (_from IS NULL OR created_at::date >= _from)
      AND (_to IS NULL OR created_at::date <= _to)
  ), page AS (
    SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN _sort = 'oldest' THEN created_at END ASC,
      CASE WHEN _sort = 'last_activity' THEN (info->>'last_activity_at')::timestamptz END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN _sort = 'access_end' THEN (info->>'access_ends_at')::timestamptz END ASC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN _sort = 'next_due' THEN (info->>'next_due_on')::date END ASC NULLS LAST,
      created_at DESC
    LIMIT lim OFFSET off
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('counts', (SELECT c FROM counts), 'total', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered), 'page_size', lim,
    'rows', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pg)) FROM page pg), '[]'::jsonb)) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END; $function$
funcoes.argumentos: _actor_user_id uuid, _search text, _status text, _access text, _financial text, _from date, _to date, _sort text, _page integer, _page_size integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_professional_row(_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  acc public.accounts%ROWTYPE; sub public.account_subscriptions%ROWTYPE;
  onboarded boolean; g_free public.access_grants%ROWTYPE; g_trial public.access_grants%ROWTYPE;
  any_grant boolean; open_pay record; last_act timestamptz; st text; access text; fin text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = _account_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO sub FROM public.account_subscriptions WHERE account_id = _account_id;
  SELECT coalesce(bool_or(p.onboarding_completed), false) INTO onboarded FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.account_id = _account_id;
  SELECT * INTO g_free FROM public.access_grants g WHERE g.account_id = _account_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND (g.kind = 'legacy' OR (g.kind = 'admin_trial' AND g.starts_at <= now() AND g.ends_at > now()))
    ORDER BY (g.kind = 'admin_trial') DESC, g.ends_at DESC LIMIT 1;
  SELECT * INTO g_trial FROM public.access_grants g WHERE g.account_id = _account_id AND g.kind = 'standard_trial' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY g.ends_at DESC LIMIT 1;
  any_grant := EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.access_grants g WHERE g.account_id = _account_id AND g.kind <> 'legacy');
  SELECT p.amount_cents, p.due_on INTO open_pay FROM public.payments p
    WHERE p.account_id = _account_id AND p.status::text NOT IN ('confirmed','cancelled','refunded') AND p.paid_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY p.due_on LIMIT 1;
  SELECT max(u.occurred_at) INTO last_act FROM public.usage_events u WHERE u.account_id = _account_id;

  st := CASE
    WHEN acc.status <> 'active' OR acc.blocked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'suspended'
    WHEN NOT onboarded THEN 'incomplete'
    WHEN open_pay.due_on IS NOT NULL AND open_pay.due_on < current_date THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN open_pay.due_on IS NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('payment_pending','grace_period','awaiting_first_payment') AND sub.next_due_on < current_date THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN open_pay.due_on IS NOT NULL OR (sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('payment_pending','grace_period','awaiting_first_payment')) THEN 'payment_pending'
    WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('active','cancellation_requested') THEN 'active'
    WHEN g_free.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'free'
    WHEN g_trial.id IS NOT NULL AND g_trial.starts_at <= now() AND g_trial.ends_at > now() AND g_trial.ends_at <= now() + interval '2 days' THEN 'trial_ending'
    WHEN g_trial.id IS NOT NULL AND g_trial.starts_at <= now() AND g_trial.ends_at > now() THEN 'trial'
    WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text = 'restricted' THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text = 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled'
    WHEN any_grant THEN 'trial_expired'
    ELSE 'recent' END;
  access := CASE
    WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('active','cancellation_requested','payment_pending','grace_period','restricted') THEN 'paid'
    WHEN g_free.id IS NOT NULL AND g_free.kind = 'legacy' THEN 'legacy'
    WHEN g_free.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'admin_free'
    WHEN g_trial.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'trial'
    ELSE 'none' END;
  fin := CASE
    WHEN open_pay.due_on IS NOT NULL AND open_pay.due_on < current_date THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN open_pay.due_on IS NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('payment_pending','grace_period','awaiting_first_payment') AND sub.next_due_on < current_date THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN open_pay.due_on IS NOT NULL THEN 'pending'
    WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('payment_pending','grace_period','awaiting_first_payment') THEN 'pending'
    WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL AND sub.status::text IN ('active','cancellation_requested') THEN 'up_to_date'
    ELSE 'not_configured' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', st, 'access_type', access, 'financial', fin,
    'access_ends_at', CASE WHEN g_free.id IS NOT NULL AND g_free.kind = 'admin_trial' THEN g_free.ends_at
                           WHEN st IN ('trial','trial_ending','trial_expired') THEN g_trial.ends_at END,
    'next_due_on', coalesce(open_pay.due_on, CASE WHEN sub.status::text IN ('active','cancellation_requested','payment_pending','grace_period','awaiting_first_payment') THEN sub.next_due_on END),
    'next_amount_cents', coalesce(open_pay.amount_cents, CASE WHEN sub.status::text IN ('active','cancellation_requested','payment_pending','grace_period','awaiting_first_payment') THEN sub.contracted_price_cents END),
    'last_activity_at', last_act, 'onboarded', onboarded);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_subscription_detail(_actor_user_id uuid, _account_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_billing_admin(_actor_user_id, true);
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'account_id', a.id, 'created_at', a.created_at, 'account_status', a.status, 'full_name', p.full_name, 'email', u.email,
    'summary', public.account_commercial_summary(a.id),
    'events', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC) FROM (SELECT action, previous_values, new_values, reason, created_at, actor_user_id FROM public.access_grant_events WHERE account_id = a.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50) e), '[]'::jsonb),
    'notifications', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC) FROM (SELECT kind, title, in_app_status, external_status, attempts, last_error, read_at, suppressed_at, created_at FROM public.professional_notifications WHERE account_id = a.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50) n), '[]'::jsonb),
    'payments', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.cycle_number DESC NULLS LAST) FROM (SELECT cycle_number, amount_cents, due_on, paid_at, status, method FROM public.payments WHERE account_id = a.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50) x), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO result
  FROM public.accounts a LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = a.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.id = _account_id;
  IF result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conta não encontrada.'; END IF;
  RETURN result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_subscription_directory(_actor_user_id uuid, _search text, _state text, _page integer, _page_size integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; q text := lower(coalesce(trim(_search), '')); lim integer := least(greatest(coalesce(_page_size, 20), 1), 50); off integer := greatest(coalesce(_page, 1) - 1, 0) * least(greatest(coalesce(_page_size, 20), 1), 50);
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_billing_admin(_actor_user_id, true);
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.created_at, p.full_name, u.email::text AS email, public.account_commercial_summary(a.id) AS summary
    FROM public.accounts a
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = a.owner_user_id
    LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = a.owner_user_id
    WHERE a.status <> 'closed'
      AND (q = '' OR lower(coalesce(p.full_name, '')) LIKE '%' || q || '%' OR lower(coalesce(u.email::text, '')) LIKE '%' || q || '%')
  ), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM base WHERE coalesce(_state, 'all') = 'all' OR summary->>'state' = _state)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),
    'rows', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT lim OFFSET off) f), '[]'::jsonb))
  INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_subscription_overview(_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_billing_admin(_actor_user_id, true);
  WITH st AS (SELECT a.id, public.account_commercial_state(a.id) AS state FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.status <> 'closed')
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (SELECT count(*) FROM st),
    'trial', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state = 'trial'),
    'trial_ending', (SELECT count(*) FROM st JOIN public.access_grants g ON g.account_id = st.id AND g.kind = 'standard_trial' WHERE st.state = 'trial' AND g.ends_at <= now() + interval '2 days'),
    'expired', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state = 'awaiting_contract'),
    'admin_trial', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state = 'admin_trial'),
    'active', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state = 'active'),
    'legacy', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state = 'legacy'),
    'pending', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state = 'payment_pending'),
    'overdue_or_suspended', (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE state IN ('overdue','suspended')),
    'revenue_month_cents', (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents), 0) FROM public.payments WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND confirmed_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'),
    'last_job', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('started_at', started_at, 'finished_at', finished_at, 'failures', failures, 'result', result) FROM public.subscription_job_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.appointment_finance_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_account_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT am.account_id
  FROM public.account_members am
  JOIN public.accounts a ON a.id = am.account_id
  WHERE am.user_id = auth.uid()
    AND am.status = 'active'
    AND a.status = 'active'
    AND a.blocked_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
    WHERE ur.account_id = am.account_id
      AND ur.user_id = am.user_id
      AND ur.role = 'owner'
  ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, am.created_at
  LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_commercial_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE acc uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT am.account_id INTO acc FROM public.account_members am WHERE am.user_id = auth.uid() AND am.status = 'active' ORDER BY am.created_at LIMIT 1;
  IF acc IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conta não encontrada.'; END IF;
  RETURN public.account_commercial_summary(acc) || jsonb_build_object(
    'contract_requested_at', (SELECT max(created_at) FROM public.access_grant_events WHERE account_id = acc AND action = 'contract.requested'),
    'notifications', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC) FROM (SELECT id, kind, title, body, action_path, read_at, created_at FROM public.professional_notifications WHERE account_id = acc AND suppressed_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) n), '[]'::jsonb));
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.patient_registration_duplicates(_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, birth_date date, email text, phone text, reasons text[])
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE target_request public.patient_registration_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO target_request FROM public.patient_registration_requests WHERE patient_registration_requests.id = _request_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT public.is_account_member(target_request.account_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solicitação não encontrada.'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.birth_date, p.email, p.phone,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
      CASE WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.cpf,''), '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(target_request.cpf, '\D', '', 'g') THEN 'CPF' END,
      CASE WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND lower(p.email) = lower(target_request.email) THEN 'E-mail' END,
      CASE WHEN lower(p.full_name) = lower(target_request.full_name) AND p.birth_date = target_request.birth_date THEN 'Nome e nascimento' END
    ], NULL)
  FROM public.patients p
  WHERE p.account_id = target_request.account_id AND (
    regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.cpf,''), '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(target_request.cpf, '\D', '', 'g')
    OR (p.email IS NOT NULL AND lower(p.email) = lower(target_request.email))
    OR (lower(p.full_name) = lower(target_request.full_name) AND p.birth_date = target_request.birth_date)
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_attendance_pricing(_single_cents integer, _package_cents integer, _quantity integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE aid uuid := public.current_account_id();
BEGIN
  IF NOT coalesce(public.can_manage_professional_finance(aid),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sem permissão para alterar valores.'; END IF;
  IF _single_cents IS NULL OR _single_cents < 0 OR _package_cents IS NULL OR _package_cents < 0 OR _quantity IS NULL OR _quantity < 2 OR _quantity > 52 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Revise os valores informados.'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.account_attendance_pricing(account_id,single_session_cents,package_total_cents,package_quantity,updated_by)
  VALUES (aid,_single_cents,_package_cents,_quantity,auth.uid())
  ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET single_session_cents=EXCLUDED.single_session_cents, package_total_cents=EXCLUDED.package_total_cents, package_quantity=EXCLUDED.package_quantity, updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at=now();
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_basic_registrations(target_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.specialties (account_id, name)
  SELECT target_account_id, seed.name FROM (VALUES
    ('Psicologia'),('Psicanálise'),('Neuropsicopedagogia'),('Psicopedagogia'),('Terapia'),('Neuropsicologia'),('Psiquiatria'),('Avaliação Psicológica'),('Orientação Profissional'),('Terapia Ocupacional'),('Fonoaudiologia'),('Nutrição'),('Serviço Social'),('Outra')
  ) AS seed(name)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.specialties s WHERE s.account_id = target_account_id AND lower(regexp_replace(btrim(s.name), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(seed.name), '\s+', ' ', 'g')));

  INSERT INTO public.appointment_types (account_id, name, default_duration_minutes, category)
  SELECT target_account_id, seed.name, seed.duration, seed.category FROM (VALUES
    ('Atendimento Clínico',50,'atendimento'),('Avaliação',90,'avaliacao'),('Devolutiva',50,'devolutiva'),('Reunião Externa',60,'reuniao'),('Entrevista Inicial',60,'avaliacao'),('Orientação',50,'atendimento'),('Supervisão',60,'atendimento'),('Acompanhamento',50,'atendimento'),('Reunião com Responsável',60,'reuniao'),('Reunião Escolar',60,'reuniao'),('Outro',60,'outro')
  ) AS seed(name,duration,category)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointment_types a WHERE a.account_id = target_account_id AND lower(regexp_replace(btrim(a.name), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(seed.name), '\s+', ' ', 'g')));
END;
$function$
